scope: Refine the existing nonmodal notice; preserve service-worker registration, activation, caching and explicit reload behavior.
environment: Local production build with an isolated localhost worker fixture. No deployed-site or account changes.
browserChecks: Desktop at 1280x720 in light and dark themes.
Actual application in a 390x844 same-origin iframe viewport in light and dark themes; browser viewport override was ineffective.
Both actions measure 44px high; the notice has no horizontal overflow at either tested width.
Update now shows activation progress and disables both actions.
A deliberately stalled fixture worker produces timeout feedback and re-enables both actions.
Later dismisses the notice without reloading the page.

automatedChecks.pwaProviderTests: 9 passed, including duplicate activation prevention and retry after timeout.

sourceChecks: Accessible status announcements, heading and visible keyboard focus styling.
Reduced-motion CSS disables spinner and button transitions; no entrance animation added.
limitations: Phone checks use a real constrained browser frame, not a physical phone. OS installation and deployed HTTPS delivery were outside this visual refinement.
